t: Masterplug LDCT2513BQ/4-XD cable reel delivers robust power distribution for outdoor construction, landscaping, and site work. This heavy-duty 13A four-socket reel features a sturdy steel frame that withstands demanding on-site conditions whilst the 25 metre cable unwinds to reach distant work areas. Thermal overload protection guards against circuit faults, and safety shutters prevent accidental contact with live socket terminals. The integrated cable guide simplifies winding whilst the carry handle enables convenient transport between job locations. At 3120W unwound capacity, this reel powers multiple tools and equipment simultaneously.
